title: BuildManifest
description: The JSON document `notlob build` writes to a temporary file and passes, as its first argument, to the script named by `~on-build` in binding.lob. It describes what this build produced. A single-module build (`notlob build <file>`) lists only that module; a whole-project build lists every module, so a hook written for the whole set should check what it was given. `version` is bumped on a breaking change.

artifacts.description: Absolute paths of the built output files, one per module built.

entry_points.description: The subset of `artifacts` whose source modules contain `~run` claims, i.e. program entry points as opposed to library modules. A hook that needs the main artifact to bundle or execute should read this list, not `artifacts`.

externals.description: Absolute paths of the files declared with `~external` in binding.lob.

language.description: The `~language` of the project, or null when none is declared (Python is then the default).

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project root (the directory holding binding.lob).

output_dir.description: Absolute path of the output directory the artifacts were written to.
